checkedAlternates.risk: Fermata often appears at the end of a section.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A fermata holds a note or rest longer than its written value (group-1), rather than directing page jumps (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Natural is sometimes mistaken for a clef or key-signature reset.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Natural (♮) is a pitch accidental that cancels a sharp or flat (group-3), not a staff clef (group-4).
